notes.title: Friendy Sheeps is Now Released!
notes.content:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

We thank you all for your overwhelming support, which greatly exceeded my expectations! It melts my heart to know that thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

Here is the update notes for Friendly Sheep
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:


[h2]Added Achievments[/h2]

[*] 16 new Achievments have ben added to the game.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45172141/266128f33833916b55a169adbad7e323a973cc15.png[/img]

[h2]Added Special Drop Box Cart[/h2]
You can now [b]fullfill[/b] Orders from Villagers with requests. Complete them and get money. But be carefull they have time. There are around [b]50 orders[/b] balanced by level, the higher the level better the reward.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45172141/2ed7596685f8979f7c59f32da8f51f2ef7ca2d42.png[/img]

[h2]🆕 UI Redesign – Better, Faster, More Immersive![/h2]
We’re thrilled to introduce a major UI overhaul that enhances both the look and usability of the game. We’ve taken your feedback into account and redesigned key elements to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Whether you're a new player or a veteran, you’ll notice an immediate improvement in navigation, readability, and overall aesthetics!

We’d love to hear what you think! Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update, and we’re always looking for ways to improve even further. Let us know your thoughts in the comments or on our Discord!

Jump in and check out the new UI now! We hope this makes your time in Friendly Sheeps even more enjoyable. As always, thanks for your support!

[h2]Quick Fix[/h2]
[*] Fixed items going out of the farm.
[*] Fixed when changing the name of the animal the players action didn't stop.
[*] Adjusted some fonts and text sizes.
[*] Adjusted some Translations.


If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
[url=https://discord.gg/kBaCWcu6]Click here to join our Discord.[/url]

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.04!

Thanks,
ACGames

notes.title: Friendly Sheeps is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, Friendly Sheeps Community!

🎉 We have some exciting news for you! 🎉

The moment you've eagerly anticipated has arrived. Friendly Sheeps is now available on Steam!
Don't miss out on having your copy today and embark on your relaxing sheep farming adventure!

About the Languages Supported.
Friendly Sheeps is a game that sincerely accepts community help. All localized languages ​​of Friendly Sheeps were created with the love of the community! If you encounter translation issues while playing the game, please feel free to let us know about these issues on our Discord. Together, we can help make Friendly Sheeps the best game about Sheep in the world!


Supported Languages are:
English
Spanish
German
French
Italian 
Russian
Portuguese - Brazil
Turkish
Italian
Simplified Chinese
Korean
Japanese

notes.title: New demo version available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce an update for the demo of my game! This new version comes with tons of bug fixes, environment improvements and save system

I want to thank you all for the amazing support so far. Since I'm developing the game on my own, your feedback and recommendations are super important to me. I want to create the best cozy game possible, and your opinions really help me shape the future of the project.

Feel free to join the Discord channel to share your thoughts on this update: https://discord.gg/vS3B6j4X. I'd love to hear what you think! and you will also be able to see some of the new features on the early access game

Thanks again, and dont forget... be a friendly with your sheeps!

notes.title: New demo available
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm super excited to announce that a new demo for my game is now available for download! I've poured a lot of hard work and love into this, and I truly hope you enjoy it.

Please keep in mind that this is a demo, so you might come across some bugs or unfinished features. Rest assured, I’m continuously working on improvements and updates.

Your feedback is incredibly important to me, so please share your thoughts and suggestions on our Discord server. Join us here: https://discord.gg/vS3B6j4X
Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!

Cheers
